name: MOT_TERR_AFFCT_BATCHES
description: This table is used for improving the reassignment of sales territories to work objects after a territory realignment process occurs, or when stage data is propogated. Specifically this table will hold the batches of territories that are affected by realignment. Each realignment will cause a batch to be created and affected territories will be grouped under this batch.

columns.name: CREATED_ON_DATE
columns.description: This indicates the date and time when the batch was inserted into the table.

columns.name: CLOSED_ON_DATE
columns.description: This indicates the date and time when the batch status of the row was changed to "CLOSED".

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates the state of the batch row. A status 'OPEN' indicates that the batch record has just been created. A status 'CLOSED' indicates that the list of affected territories associated with this batch record has been written to territory reassignment table.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).
